ashwin: Quick preflight for the new quant onboard (mpt-xxb). I pushed the candidate weights to s3://redwood-models/onboard/mpt-xxb/awq-v2/ — please sanity-check before I kick off the calibration run.

ashwin: Two immediate gotchas I ran into locally: our HF tokenizer's BOS token is `1` but the serving tokenizer (legacy) expects `0`. That causes a one-token offset in some few-shot prompts. Also the model config in the repo sets `max_seq_len: 2048` but the weights were exported with 4096 positional embeddings. Need consensus on canonical config.

marta: Copying/checksum command I used:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/onboard/mpt-xxb/awq-v2/model.safetensors ./model.safetensors
sha256sum model.safetensors
```
I got a different sha256 from the upload manifest (manifest.json). Reuploading now, will post new checksum.

devops-bot: backup created for s3://redwood-models/onboard/mpt-xxb/awq-v2 at 2026-03-16T14:02:11Z (id: bk-20260316-140211).

sasha: Calibration note — I ran AWQ calibration with a 5k prompt sample (diverse web+docs mix). AWQ run shows a ~2.1% perplexity increase on our LM eval, GPTQ (8-bit) shows ~0.9%. FP8 gave mixed results: faster but we hit inf/nan in attention once (layer 23) on long-context tests.

raj: The FP8 NaN looks like an underflow in the attention kernel for certain keys; seen before when kv-cache prealloc size != actual sequence. We should gate FP8 behind the runtime patch that clamps softmax inputs. Not safe to roll to prod yet.

kevin: For the onboarding checklist I need explicit numbers and a rollout plan. Can you list: (a) calibration dataset size & provenance, (b) exact eval metrics delta vs float32 (perplexity / MMLU where available), (c) proposed canary % and fallback.

ashwin: (a) calib set: 5k prompts: 60% webdocs, 20% code-snippets, 20% qa/dialogue — sampled from existing eval pool (seed 42).
(b) metrics: AWQ: +2.1% PPL, -0.6% MMLU; GPTQ: +0.9% PPL, -0.2% MMLU; FP8: variable, PPL +3.5% at times and instability on long context.
(c) rollout: propose AWQ for latency-sensitive endpoints with canary 10% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback if token-level perplexity regresses >1.5% or error rate increases by >0.3%. Fallback chain: AWQ -> GPTQ -> float32 in that order.

kevin: OK, sign-off conditionally. Fine to proceed with AWQ canary at 10% for one service (api-west) only. Do NOT enable FP8. Add a monitor in Console: route-level perplexity delta alert and 5m token-err spike alert. Also open a PR with rollout config and health checks.

sasha: I'll add the monitor and update the canary config. Will also add a small eval job to run nightly on the canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4872 (WIP).

marta: Re-uploaded model.safetensors; new sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (truncated) — matched manifest now. Also patched tokenizer mapping so we accept bos_id=1 and remap to serving bos=0 during tokenization (temporary shim).

raj: I'll queue the runtime softmax-clamp patch for eng-runtime and add a unit that exercises long-context attention with synthetic keys. If it passes, we can revisit FP8 in a future release.

kevin: Good. One more ask — add a short runbook blurb in the PR describing rollback steps and which logs to inspect (model latency buckets, token-error traces, eval harness output).

ashwin: Will do, updating PR now. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

sasha: tagging this for follow-up in tomorrow async sync. (react :eyes:)

ashwin: Closing this thread for now — will post canary start timestamp when we flip 10%.
